title: How to wash microfibre cloths

pieces.say: Your microfibre cloths stopped working. Here's why.
pieces.text: Your microfibre cloths stopped working. Here's why.
pieces.label: YOU'RE DOING IT WRONG

pieces.say: Here's the problem. Fabric softener clogs the fibres.
Wash them on their own, at forty to sixty degrees.
Use just a little liquid detergent.
Skip the fabric softener and dryer sheets.
Air dry, or tumble on low.
And no bleach, it breaks down the fibres.
They grab dust like new again.

result.say: They grab dust like new again.
result.headline: Grippy again

pieces.say: Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
